## Validation / 验证

- Commands and results / 检查命令与结果：
- Devices, OS and untested platforms / 设备、系统及未验证的平台：
- UI screenshots; camera/tracking reproduction or video / 界面截图；相机／跟踪复现步骤或视频：
- Significant AI assistance and human review (if used) / 主要 AI 辅助部分及人工核查（如有）：

## Review / 审查

- [ ] Focused change without unrelated refactoring / 改动聚焦，无无关重构
- [ ] Behavior changes have regression evidence / 行为变化有回归依据
- [ ] Permissions, network/data use and dependencies explained / 已说明权限、网络、数据及依赖变化
- [ ] English/Chinese docs updated where relevant / 相关中英文文档已同步
- [ ] No credentials, private photos or build output / 无凭据、私人照片或构建产物
